name: nail
description: Nail email & PIM client (npm workspaces root)

scripts.test: node scripts/check-socket-binds.mjs && npm run test -w ui && npm run test -w packages --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w ui && cargo build -p nail-cli && npm run build:desktop && npm run test -w e2e
scripts.gen:api: cross-env NAIL_UPDATE_BINDINGS=1 cargo test -p nail-api --test bindings
